name: routed-row-lands-during-the-glide
description: A typed URL that a rule claims opens in Work, and the window glides the rail from Home to Work. The snapshot push that carries the routed tab's row lands while that glide runs. It used to park until the rail settled, about 0.9s, so the tab was on screen with no row. Same fixture and prelude as routing-moves-the-tab. A MutationObserver in the sidebar records whether the swipe loop was still running (.swipelock on the root) at the moment the row appears. The push lands one frame into the glide, 0.18px in on the 2026-09-10 run, so an offset check cannot tell it from rest.

actions.note: gate: the Home tab committed, so the app and the profile are live

actions.expression: (() => { window.__rowWatch = {seen: null}; const mo = new MutationObserver(() => { if (window.__rowWatch.seen) { return; } const row = document.querySelector('.tabrow[data-url*="corp.example"]'); if (!row) { return; } const rail = document.querySelector('.rail'); const m = /translateX\((-?[\d.]+)px\)/.exec((rail && rail.style.transform) || ''); window.__rowWatch.seen = {px: m ? Number(m[1]) : 0, gliding: !!document.querySelector('.swipelock')}; }); mo.observe(document.body, {childList: true, subtree: true}); return 'armed'; })()
actions.note: records whether the rail was still gliding (root carries .swipelock while a settle runs) when the routed row first entered the DOM
commit the typed URL: the route, the glide, and the push

actions.pattern: Atrium: routed http://corp\.example into space 437a0001-0000-4000-8000-00000000ad01, opened there

actions.expression: (() => { const s = window.__rowWatch && window.__rowWatch.seen; if (!s) { return 'no row seen'; } return s.gliding ? 'row landed during the glide' : 'row landed after the glide at ' + s.px; })()

(() => { const rail = document.querySelector('.rail'); const w = rail.parentElement.clientWidth || 260; const m = /translateX\((-?[\d.]+)px\)/.exec(rail.style.transform || ''); return String(Math.round(-Number(m ? m[1] : 0) / w)); })()
actions.note: the glide still arrived: Work is pane 3 (Overview, Home, Personal, Work)

assertions.desc: VACUITY GUARD: the observer was installed before the commit
